title: Una sociedad en transformación
goal: Read a closing synthesis of how modernization ran at two speeds -- dazzling change in the cities, almost none in much of the countryside -- and why "modernization" needs to specify for whom.
grammar: Correlativos formales: no solo... sino también

items: Summarize what had transformed in Latin America by 1900.
Explain whether this transformation reached the whole population equally.
Describe what still organized daily life in many indigenous rural regions.
Explain the cultural gap this double speed created between urban elites and rural compatriots.
Use no solo... sino también to stack two related claims in a formal sentence.
